agents.label: Ollama - local
agents.notes: A local endpoint with no key. Model listing is read from GET /models; the model here is optional.

agents.label: OpenRouter
agents.notes: Replace the reserved example origin with the origin the provider documents. Put the key in the named environment variable, not in this file.

agents.label: OpenCode Go
agents.notes: Replace the reserved example origin and model id. The key is read at request time, so rotating the environment variable takes effect on the next turn.

security: Never commit a real key to this file.
Alternatively set apiKeyFile to an absolute path of a regular 0600 file under the runtime directory.
A key is never returned by the gateway API and is replaced with [redacted] in error text.
